instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Critical operations, dependencies and disruption impact inform continuity priorities; BIA is a process, not a recovery target or a completed impact analysis.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Useful process vocabulary after a continuity miss, but the definition does not teach impact scoring, MTD versus RTO, dependency prioritization or how to conduct the analysis.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Sensitive-data movement detection or blocking according to policy; confidentiality context does not imply every CIA property or a fixed detective/preventive category.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: May refresh the purpose of content/egress controls; it does not identify where a policy applies, false-positive tradeoffs, data classification or the best control in a scenario.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Extensible framework for authentication methods used in network access; neither an encryption algorithm nor one uniformly strong authentication method.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Refreshes framework recognition; choosing an EAP method, validating server trust, AAA roles and Zero Trust decisions require separate instruction.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Federation provider authenticates users and issues identity assertions or tokens; it is not interchangeable with authorization policy or an LDAP protocol.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Helps distinguish provider from relying party at vocabulary level; issuer/audience validation, trust configuration and authorization decisions are absent.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Protocol for directory query and modification; directory access is distinct from an identity-provider service, federation assertion format and encrypted transport.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Refreshes directory purpose; it does not teach bind security, TLS, directory permissions, ports or protocol selection for network-device administration.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Average interval between failures of repairable systems; not non-repairable lifetime, restoration duration or a per-incident deadline.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Semantically useful reliability vocabulary but no verified local inline-tooltip occurrence; a card or table mention cannot be claimed as delivered glossary remediation.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: The authored definition mixes failure repair with incident response timing; exact recovery.mttr linkage is withheld pending a repair/recover versus respond distinction.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Unsafe as targeted recovery correction while two different clocks are combined; the prior repair/recover card and table are narrower and must retain their dispositions.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Delegated resource authorization through tokens, distinct from OIDC authentication; not a claim that every historical grant avoids disclosing a password.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Useful authorization-versus-login reminder; scopes, grants, audience and token validation remain untaught, so reading this does not repair a protocol-selection miss.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Authentication and identity claims layered on OAuth 2.0; neither an access-token-only login shortcut nor an assurance that claims are validated.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Useful contrast with OAuth when a learner opens PBQ feedback; it does not teach flow selection, ID-token validation or relying-party trust.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Certificate-based public-key trust infrastructure comprising authorities, certificates, policies and keys; supporting encryption does not itself guarantee protected data.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Refreshes certificate trust context; certificate lifecycle, path validation, revocation, key usage and a Zero Trust policy role require additional teaching.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Acceptable data loss expressed as a time interval to a recovery point; distinct from restoration duration and actual successful recovery.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Refreshes the data-loss clock, but cannot choose a backup strategy, compute recovery loss from a scenario or distinguish every continuity metric.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Acceptable service restoration time target after disruption; distinct from data-loss tolerance, MTTR average and maximum tolerable business disruption.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Refreshes restoration timing, but the definition does not teach MTD relationships, acceptable service levels, strategy selection or evidence that a target was met.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: XML assertion exchange for authentication, attributes or authorization contexts, commonly used in federated SSO; assertion format is not the user experience itself.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Helps recognize XML assertion vocabulary; issuer, audience, signature, replay protections and SAML versus OIDC deployment selection are absent.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: One login/session across multiple applications; sign-in experience is distinct from federation across trust domains and from any single assertion protocol.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Refreshes the one-login experience; it does not establish federation trust, provisioning, session security or authentication/authorization separation.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Network-device administration AAA protocol with separated functions; preserve the plus identity and withhold any inference that legacy packet obfuscation is modern encryption.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Useful device-administration vocabulary, but the encrypted-payload wording needs a separate content correction before security assurances or protocol-selection remediation are approved.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Secure encrypted VPN connection over an untrusted network in this authored context; not every service bearing a VPN label, encryption algorithm or end-to-end application guarantee.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Refreshes tunnel purpose; endpoint trust, split tunneling, IPsec/TLS selection, routing, key management and per-application protection are not taught.

selectorBinding.limitation: Definitions are conditional inline support; corpus matches do not prove a browser tooltip was opened.

separatelyScopedFollowups.detail: Distinguish repair/recover from incident response clock before canonical linkage; do not change the prior card/table or invent a new concept here.
Replace the implication of modern encrypted payload security with accurate RFC8907 obfuscation and secured-transport context; no teaching edit in this slice.
Do not fabricate a tooltip occurrence from card/table/reference metadata; a later delivery change or real occurrence needs separate verification.

humanDecisionReferences.ownerDecision: All proposals remain pending; no queue closure, competence, publication or migration approval.
